name: Pawn Shop
considerations: Pawn loans are collateralized consumer loans; forfeited collateral becomes inventory at loan principal (or lower of cost/NRV). Track tickets, hold periods and reporting to law enforcement. In Texas pawnshops are licensed by the OCCC; firearms require an FFL; cash purchases may trigger BSA/AML reporting (Form 8300, CTR).

name: Construction (General & Specialty Contractors)
considerations: Revenue recognized over time (ASC 606, cost-to-cost percent complete) or completed-contract for small contractors (tax). Maintain job cost by job/phase/cost code, WIP schedule, retainage, change orders. Certified payroll for prevailing wage jobs; bonding capacity depends on clean financials.

name: Cemetery
considerations: Perpetual (endowment) care trust corpus is restricted; earnings fund maintenance. Pre-need property revenue recognized when constructed and delivered; merchandise when delivered. Many states (incl. Texas) require trust deposits for care funds and merchandise.

name: Funeral Home
considerations: FTC Funeral Rule requires itemized General Price List. Pre-need contracts funded by trust or insurance; revenue deferred until service delivered. Cash advance items (flowers, obituaries, clergy) are pass-through. Texas pre-need sellers regulated by the Department of Banking; funeral directors by the Texas Funeral Service Commission.

name: Oil & Gas - Downstream (Refining & Marketing)
considerations: Inventory often LIFO; crack spread margins. RFS compliance via RINs. Federal and state fuel excise taxes.

name: Oil & Gas - Midstream (Pipelines, Processing, Storage)
considerations: Fee-based or percent-of-proceeds contracts. Regulated by FERC (interstate) and PHMSA (safety). Track throughput volumes and line-fill.

name: Oil & Gas - Upstream (Exploration & Production)
considerations: Choose successful efforts (ASC 932) or full cost method. Track by lease/well (AFE). DD&A uses units-of-production on proved reserves. Joint interest billing (JIB) under COPAS. Texas wells regulated by the Railroad Commission; severance taxes on oil and gas.

name: Oilfield Services
considerations: Revenue on field tickets; track by job and rig. High equipment intensity and HSE costs.

name: Furniture Manufacturing & Wholesale
considerations: Material-intensive; track lumber yield and fabric usage. Market showrooms (High Point, Las Vegas) are major selling costs.

name: Manufacturing
considerations: Uses job-order or process costing with standard costs; track material, labor and overhead variances. Capitalize overhead into inventory. Consider R&D credit (Sec. 41) and UNICAP.

name: Fix & Flip Real Estate
considerations: Flip properties are inventory, not rental assets - no depreciation. Capitalize acquisition, rehab, holding and financing costs into each property; relieve to cost of sales at closing. Profits are generally ordinary income (dealer status) and may be subject to self-employment tax.

name: Real Estate - Brokerage & Property Management
considerations: Trust/escrow funds belong to clients - never commingle; reconcile trust accounts monthly (three-way). Texas brokers licensed by TREC. Agent splits are usually cost of revenue.

name: Real Estate - Development & Homebuilding
considerations: Land, development and construction costs are inventory (not fixed assets). Capitalize interest during development (ASC 835-20). Allocate common costs to lots/units by relative sales value.

name: Real Estate - Rental & Investment Property
considerations: Track each property as a class/location. Land not depreciated; residential buildings 27.5 yrs, commercial 39 yrs (US). Security deposits are liabilities, often held in trust. Consider cost segregation, 1031 exchanges and passive activity rules.

name: Convenience Store (No Fuel)
considerations: High-volume, low-ticket store. Lottery, money orders and bill pay are agent services - funds collected are liabilities, only commissions are revenue. Beer & wine permit (TABC in Texas). Track shrink by category.

name: Convenience Store with Gas Station
considerations: Includes all convenience store accounts plus fuel. Track fuel gallons, margin per gallon, and book-to-physical variance by grade. UST registration, monitoring and financial responsibility (TCEQ in Texas). Dealer vs. commission-agent fuel models differ in revenue recognition.

name: Furniture Retail
considerations: Large special-order deposits, floor model markdowns and delivery operations. Promotional financing fees are a significant cost.

name: Jewelry Retail
considerations: High-value inventory with memo/consignment arrangements; goods on memo-in are NOT owned and stay off the balance sheet (track in memo log). Jewelers' block insurance, AML program required for dealers in precious metals/stones (31 CFR 1027).

name: Retail (General Merchandise)
considerations: Uses perpetual inventory (or retail inventory method). Key metrics: gross margin, shrink, sell-through. Gift cards and returns create liabilities; recognize breakage per ASC 606.

name: Smoke & Vape Shop - Retail
considerations: Strict age verification (21+ federally). Tobacco/vapor retail permits required (Texas Comptroller). Manufacturer buydowns and scan-data programs reduce cost. Federal PACT Act governs remote vape sales.

name: Jewelry Wholesale & Manufacturing
considerations: Memo consignment is common; gold often held via metal accounts or leases. Consider hedging gold price exposure.

name: Tobacco & Smoke Products - Wholesale
considerations: Wholesalers affix state cigarette tax stamps and remit OTP taxes; strict permit and bonding requirements; PACT Act monthly reports.

name: Wholesale / Distribution
considerations: Margins thin; landed cost accuracy, rebates and freight are critical. Track customer deductions and vendor chargebacks. Consider warehouse labor capitalization in inventory (UNICAP Sec. 263A if over threshold).

name: Agriculture - Crop Farm
considerations: Growing crops inventory; USDA program payments.

name: Hemp / CBD Business
considerations: Regulated by state/USDA; check local legality.

name: Auto Dealership - New Vehicles
considerations: Floor plan financing; F&I income; manufacturer incentives and holdback.

name: Auto Repair Shop
considerations: Parts and labor tracked by repair order; technician efficiency.

name: Used Car Dealer / Buy Here Pay Here
considerations: BHPH carries installment receivables and repossessions.

name: Fuel Distributor / Jobber
considerations: Licensed distributor remits motor fuel taxes.

name: Bank / Credit Union
considerations: Net interest margin; ACL under CECL.

name: Check Cashing / Money Transmitter
considerations: Licensed MSB; FinCEN registration and AML program.

name: Hospital
considerations: Net patient revenue; cost report settlements.

name: Medical Practice / Clinic
considerations: Gross charges vs contractual adjustments; payer mix.

name: Nursing Home / Assisted Living
considerations: Resident trust funds held in custody.

name: Bar / Nightclub
considerations: Pour cost and comps control; cover charges; mixed beverage taxes (Texas).

name: Hotel / Motel
considerations: RevPAR, ADR and occupancy; hotel occupancy taxes (state and local).

name: Restaurant - Full Service
considerations: Prime cost (food + labor) is the key metric; tip reporting and FICA tip credit.

name: Restaurant - Quick Service / Franchise
considerations: Franchise royalties and ad fund contributions are percent of sales.

name: Nonprofit / Charity
considerations: Net assets with/without donor restrictions (ASC 958); Form 990.

name: Government Contractor
considerations: FAR cost accounting; indirect rate pools.

name: Law Firm
considerations: IOLTA trust accounts; WIP and unbilled time.

name: Security Guard Services
considerations: Licensed by state (Texas DPS Private Security).

name: Staffing Agency
considerations: Gross payroll is cost of revenue.

name: Cannabis Dispensary (State-legal)
considerations: IRC 280E limits deductions to COGS (subject to federal rescheduling status); state seed-to-sale tracking.

name: E-commerce / Online Seller
considerations: Marketplace fees and fulfillment; economic nexus sales tax.

name: Grocery / Supermarket
considerations: Perishables shrink and vendor allowances drive margin; SNAP/WIC tender tracking.

name: Liquor Store
considerations: Package store permit required; strict inventory controls and excise compliance.

name: Sporting Goods & Firearms (FFL Dealer)
considerations: FFL, NICS checks; federal excise (FAET) applies to manufacturers/importers.

name: Franchisor
considerations: Initial franchise fees recognized over term (ASC 606).

name: Airline / Air Charter
considerations: Air traffic liability for unflown tickets; heavy maintenance.

name: Freight Broker / 3PL / Warehousing
considerations: Gross vs net revenue depends on principal/agent analysis.

name: Trucking / Freight Carrier
considerations: Revenue per mile, IFTA fuel tax, driver settlements.

name: Coin & Bullion Dealer
considerations: Spot-price exposure; AML for precious metals dealers.

name: Scrap Metal Recycler
considerations: Metal price exposure; theft reporting laws.
